literal_source_claim: Every family of nonempty sets has a choice function.
canonical_claim: For an indexed family A_i of nonempty types/sets, there exists a function f with f(i) in A_i for every index i.

canonical_formal_target.declaration_or_expression: forall (i : Sort u) (A : i -> Sort v), (forall j, Nonempty (A j)) -> Nonempty (forall j, A j)

domain_and_universes: An arbitrary index sort and dependent family of sorts; exact universe polymorphism is deferred to statement freeze.
conclusion: Nonempty (forall j, A j), equivalently existence of a dependent choice function.
alternate_encodings: product of nonempty sets is nonempty
excluded_degenerate_cases: Empty index families are included vacuously; empty fibers violate the hypothesis. Countable choice, dependent choice, unique choice, well-ordering, and Zorn's lemma are not substitutes without checked transports.
